notes.package_build: Includes Evidence retrieval and selection performed by ObjectEvidencePackageBuilder.
notes.derived_incremental_sync: Includes incremental Search Representation, Embedding, and Vector Index synchronization for the target Object.
notes.result_validation: Timing begins after the external Result has already been returned and received into the isolated benchmark workspace.

statistics.nearest_rank_definition: Sort successful formal sample total_seconds ascending and select rank ceil(0.95 * n), using one-based rank.
statistics.failure_policy: A failed or aborted formal warm sample is a formal failure and must not be removed or replaced by an additional success sample.
statistics.retry_policy: Automatic retry time is included in the sample total and retry_count must be recorded.

result_semantics.PASS: Both Standard and Large formal warm p95 values satisfy their targets, no formal warm sample failed, workload/environment evidence is valid, and required cold diagnostics exist.
result_semantics.FAIL: A valid formal workload exceeds a p95 target or any formal warm sample terminates unsuccessfully.
result_semantics.BLOCKED: Required evidence, runtime metadata, sample count, or workload validity is insufficient to make a formal performance judgment.

fixture_policy.n03_role: N-03 remains the real-data ecological seed and integration reference, but its 6 Objects / 8 Sources do not by themselves cover the Standard and Large N-05 load envelopes.
fixture_policy.load_fixture: N-05 may construct isolated deterministic synthetic load-shape fixtures derived from the canonical schemas and public workflow. Synthetic fixtures test performance load only and must not be used as retrieval-quality or semantic-quality evidence.
fixture_policy.isolation: Each repetition uses an isolated SQLite state and an isolated Qdrant collection prefix. Canonical user data must not be mutated by the benchmark.
